add.title: LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands (Wikipedia; Prisons Ordinance 2017 equal-treatment clause)
add.summary: Thin: Wikipedia's 'LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands' article documents no trans-prisoner housing data for the territory - no birth-sex vs identity placement policy, no special units, no solitary/segregation practice - but its hate-crime section notes that the Prisons Ordinance 2017 (legislation.gov.fk, in force 2019-07-17) requires prison staff to treat all prisoners equally without distinction to, among other categories, sexual orientation; a statutory equal-treatment clause covering prison staff, with no trans-specific placement or segregation detail.
